rationale: Create Vela Wind Holdco, LLC as one canonical four-project Texas wind portfolio. Record the current 51% LS Power/Clearlight, 25% RWE and 24% Schroders Greencoat interests and preserve Algonquin's former 51% ownership period through the January 2025 closing.

supports: RWE retained a current 25% interest in Vela through 2025
The ownership split was 51% Algonquin, 25% RWE and 24% Greencoat
Vela is the common holdco for the four projects
LS Power closed the Algonquin renewable-energy acquisition on January 8, 2025
Clearlight manages the acquired operating portfolio
Greencoat Vela holds the 24% Schroders Greencoat interest
The four wind farms sit below Vela

afterImage.name: Vela Wind Holdco, LLC
aliases: Texas Wind Portfolio (Stella, Cranell, East Raymond, West Raymond)
afterImage.description: Vela Wind Holdco, LLC is the common parent of the 861 MW Stella, Cranell, East Raymond and West Raymond operating wind farms in Texas. LS Power's Clearlight platform owns the former Algonquin 51% interest, RWE retains 25% and remains operator, and Schroders Greencoat owns 24% through Greencoat Vela LLC. The four project companies remain subordinate assets rather than separate portfolio companies.

milestones.event: Algonquin, RWE and Greencoat completed the first three project transfers, establishing the 51%/25%/24% ownership structure.
The parties completed the West Raymond transfer into the same Vela ownership perimeter.
LS Power completed its acquisition of Algonquin's renewable-energy business, transferring Algonquin's 51% Vela interest into the Clearlight-managed portfolio.
